gloss: coming home in the morning (after staying out all night)

definitions.gloss: coming home in the morning after staying out all night
definitions.explanation: returning home early in the morning after being out overnight, typically after partying, working late, or staying at someone's place

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝帰|あさがえ}りだった。
examples.english: I came home in the morning yesterday (after staying out all night).

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がって→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧{朝帰|あさがえ}りになってしまった。
examples.english: The drinking party got so lively that I ended up coming home in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{朝帰|あさがえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っていた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: His wife was angry about him coming home in the morning.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning) + ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧ (returning home)

COMMON SITUATIONS:
Used to describe coming home after:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ (drinking party)
- ⟦オールナイト→オールナイト：08694_oorunaito⟧ (all-night event)
- ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧ (overtime work)
- ⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧ (night shift)

USAGE:
- {朝帰|あさがえ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to come home in the morning (verb form)
- {朝帰|あさがえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to end up coming home in the morning
Often implies staying out partying or drinking until morning. Can have negative connotations when used by family members expressing disapproval.
